answer: One concrete defense is a refundable identity bond with delayed rewards. Every agent locks a deposit to join, and its earnings sit on a terrace of vesting steps that unlock only after many epochs of peer-checked work. A sybil farm hoping to sip nectar from many fake accounts must post a bond for each one and wait months to cash out, while a single proven fraud lets a watchful falcon of an auditor slash the whole linked cluster. The attack costs capital times time, and the payoff shrinks.
